datasets.description: Percentage of areas covered by bodies of water that are found on the land surface or in the subsoil, whether natural or artificial, and may be fresh, brackish or salt water. lineage.description: Water body features were extracted from OpenStreetMap and processed using GIS geoprocessing techniques to calculate the percentage coverage of water bodies (fresh, brackish, and salt water) at the municipal scale across Central America. Post-processing aggregation transformed the data from feature-level to administrative unit (municipality) scale.
